attack_tools.description: Most comprehensive tool for Hacker News comment analysis. Utilizes state-of-the-art NLP models to extract deep insights, identify nuanced opinions, track sentiment shifts, and generate executive-level summaries. Essential for understanding complex discussions and extracting hidden patterns in comment threads that standard analysis methods completely miss.
